# gitissue

> Issue-Driven Development for GitHub: eight skills that structure, analyze, triage, resolve, and review GitHub issue workflows so humans and AI coding agents can ship tested PRs (seven public packages in `src/skills/` plus internal `/idd-doctor`).

## Start here

- [Landing page](https://luongnv.com/idd/): Product overview, installation command, and workflow summary.
- [Skills reference](https://luongnv.com/idd/docs.html): Complete command reference for `/init-gitissue`, `/issue-creator`, `/issue-analysis`, `/issue-triage`, `/issue-resolver`, `/issue-pr-review`, `/auto-pilot`, and `/idd-doctor`.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/luongnv89/idd): Source code, issues, releases, and contribution workflow.
- [README](https://github.com/luongnv89/idd/blob/main/README.md): Installation, methodology, examples, and command table.

## Commands

- [`/init-gitissue`](https://luongnv.com/idd/docs.html#init-gitissue): Generate a repository-specific `.gitissue.yml` config.
- [`/issue-creator`](https://luongnv.com/idd/docs.html#issue-creator): Create, normalize, or batch-create structured GitHub issues.
- [`/issue-analysis`](https://luongnv.com/idd/docs.html#issue-analysis): Analyze one issue for root cause, affected files, implementation options, complexity, and risk.
- [`/issue-triage`](https://luongnv.com/idd/docs.html#issue-triage): Prioritize the backlog, detect dependencies, and find already-fixed signals.
- [`/issue-resolver`](https://luongnv.com/idd/docs.html#issue-resolver): Resolve one GitHub issue into an atomic pull request.
- [`/issue-pr-review`](https://luongnv.com/idd/docs.html#issue-pr-review): Review a pull request, fix issues, test, and check CI.
- [`/auto-pilot`](https://luongnv.com/idd/docs.html#auto-pilot): Run the autonomous triage → resolve → review → merge loop.
- [`/idd-doctor`](https://luongnv.com/idd/docs.html#idd-doctor): Run a read-only health check for IDD repository invariants.
